verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments API platform, so monitoring failed payments and driving retries and dunning is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack only documents one-time card charges, authorization/capture, refunds, 3DS, network tokens and payment links. Nothing in it shows webhooks for failed-payment events, automated retry logic, or dunning outreach, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt to support agent-driven workflows.
